title: Prestressed axial mode and unloaded control
source: Closed-form one-coordinate axial perturbation: M = 2/3, K = 2(E+F), and the zero-force control, with substitutions in README.md.

quantities.reason: Two equal one-metre unit-area segments: q = F ΣL/(EA) = 1000(2/1e6) = 0.002 m.
The one-coordinate axial perturbation has exact discrete mass M = 2/3 kg and tangent K = 2(E + F) = 2,002,000 N/m, so f = sqrt(K/M)/(2π).
With F = 0 the same exact discrete coordinate has K = 2E = 2,000,000 N/m and M = 2/3 kg; f = sqrt(K/M)/(2π).
